description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Meia
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Fanatical Dance (0~2), removed after using Fanatical Dance two times

description.name: Fanatical Dance Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Fanatical Dance level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Water abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Meia]

description.name: Fanatical Dance Level
description.text: Keeps track of Fanatical Dance level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Meia]
